[i]  [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/750417894667452476/install-instructions.png[/img]﻿﻿[/i]
[size=3]    [/size][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI, CP, TMXL Map toolkit, ShopTileFramework, Anti-Social Npcs, Event Repeater, and then drop into your mods folder.
QuestFramework is optional.[/size]
[size=4]To uninstall, just remove the [u][ME] Museum Expansion[/u] folder and it's done![/size]

[size=6]--------------------------------------------[/size]
[/size]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/726159947611504681/761000790101590026/configurations_1.png[/img]﻿

[size=4]First, load the game with the mod once to create the config.json file.
Then you can edit it with some text editor. We have 3 options for Charlie Portraits, there are: 
"[u]Original, FellowOriginal, FellowEdited[/u]"

All of these two were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]FellowClown[/url]﻿!

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/772212929897431060/Sprite-0002.png[/img]

﻿﻿
And we have an alternative Randy and Charlie made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]KAYA[/url]﻿ !!
The site is in Korean, but a Google Translate does the work.
Download it here:  
[url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10267145]Charlie Anime Portraits
[/url][url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10267087]Cute Randy Portraits[/url]﻿
